name: velora-platform
description: Storefront + admin panel + API in one deployable app (Vercel, cPanel, Docker).

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run build:server && npm --prefix server run migrate:built && npm --prefix server run seed:admin:built && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
